item.title: We Celebrate The Best of McKinley Park
item.description: Our members' choice contest picks neighborhood favorites in categories for dining, shopping, services and community, showcasing McKinley Park's best enterprises, organizations and features. Members' choice contest picks neighborhood favorites. Winners top categories in dining, shopping, services and community. Discover McKinley Park's best and all who call our neighborhood home.

item.title: City's Geographic Center Again Hosts Chicago's Birthday Party
item.description: The McKinley Park neighborhood celebrated Chicago for the third year in a row with music, ceremony, cake, Chicago-style hot dogs and singing Happy Birthday to Chicago in multiple languages. The McKinley Park neighborhood celebrates the City of Chicago for the third year in a row. Collaborative community party includes performances, ceremony and Chicago-style hot dogs. Event looks to continue at 37th and Honore with next celebration scheduled for March 4, 2027.

item.title: Civic Association Announces Outstanding Educators and Scholarship Winners
item.description: The McKinley Park Civic Association shared this year's winning teachers and students, plus the winner of the William H.G. Toms community service award, with the association's banquet and awards ceremony set for Sunday, April 19. McKinley Park Civic Association announces winning teachers and students. Annual William H.G. Toms Award for community service goes to Jim Krok. Winners and association members to celebrate at annual banquet on April 19.

item.title: Class-Leading Cold Storage Opens for Business in McKinley Park
item.description: Karis Cold and DSI Inc. completed construction on their new warehouse, replacing the historic Continental Can Company building at South Ashland Avenue and West Pershing Road. Karis Cold and DSI Inc. complete warehouse construction. Design-build coordination required for state-of-the-art facility. Cold storage replaces derelict Continental Can Company building.

item.title: McKinley Park Gets $2.5 Million for Storefronts and Streetscapes
item.description: Property owners and businesses on West 35th Street and South Archer Avenue can get grants for storefront improvements through the Chicago Department of Planning and Development program. $1.8 million available for property improvements. Department of Planning and Development now accepting submissions. Program area is West 35th Street from Ashland to Leavitt, and South Archer Avenue from Damen to the 35th/Archer Orange Line El.
